grounding.guards: Invented facts: the page stands on at least one passage that is word for word on the customer's own page.

rival_source.guards: Invented facts: a figure about a named rival with no link beside it.
rival_source.decision: Kept, unchanged. Never fired on stored text; its year and label matching are #1135's.

no_invented_people.guards: Invented people: a quoted remark attributed to someone who is not the customer, with no link.
no_invented_people.decision: Narrowed. A dash counts as an attribution only after the closing quotation mark or closing the block; "its data source — DataForSEO, for instance" is punctuation.

no_unsourced_testimonial.guards: Invented reviews: what customers are said to say, a rating or a recommendation, or a block quote, with no link.
no_unsourced_testimonial.decision: Narrowed. The bare words (review, testimonial, endorsement, our customers) are gone; each pattern is now a claim. The unlinked block quote stays.

honest_row.guards: A false claim about the business: on a market comparison, the business is missing from the comparison table, or the page ranks it "#1" or the best by its own word (SPEC §7, D20).
honest_row.decision: Added by #1136 in place of `brand_gap` and `page_frame`. It reads a table that names a rival, and a rank the page gives the business by its own word.

brand_gap.guards: An advert posing as an answer: the page names the business before it has answered.
brand_gap.decision: Narrowed from a 300-character window to the first sentence and the headings above it, and it decides nothing where the target search names the business. Retires with `page_frame` when #1136 ships honesty by page type. Retired by #1136.

page_frame.guards: An advert posing as an answer: on a market question, the business is the page's subject.
page_frame.decision: Narrowed to the title, or half or more of the headings. The count of mentions was a style check and is removed; one heading naming the business is the section SPEC §7 requires. Retired by #1136: how the business appears now follows the page's type.

no_hidden_text.guards: Unsafe markup: text handed to the destination that no reader sees.

no_machine_address.guards: Unsafe markup: a sentence addressed to an assistant, a crawler or a ranking system.

near_duplicate.guards: Structure: the page is not a repeat of one the site already has.

no_invented_test.guards: Invented facts: a test nobody ran.
no_invented_test.decision: Narrowed. A cited page's title inside a link is that page's claim, not ours, and "hands-on" alone is an adjective.

no_invented_provenance.guards: Invented facts: a case study the page was never given. (A byline and the page's dates are the page's own since #1137.)
no_invented_provenance.decision: Narrowed. A case study has to be claimed or offered as evidence; "look for case studies on the vendor's site" claims none. Before #1137 took bylines and dates out of this rule, it also stopped "written by a person" and "published on your domain".

no_new_question_heading.guards: Structure: the page keeps the outline's sections; the answerability pass adds none.
no_new_question_heading.decision: Kept, unchanged. Not re-measurable: no stored draft keeps its outline. It is not among the stop reasons of any of the 12 stored drafts or the 18 recorded evaluation runs (`content-eval.md`, `content-repair.md`).

traceable_numerals.guards: Invented figures: a number of 10 or more that no handed fact, no target search and no link carries.
traceable_numerals.decision: Narrowed. A figure the page cites beside a link may be repeated without one; a year is not a number (SPEC §7, 2026-09-29); digits glued to a letter are a name, not a figure; and a link is no longer cut in two at a full stop inside its label. Now also the one rule for a figure only ReachKit measured.

first_block_answers.guards: Structure: the page opens with an answer — a short-answer box of 40–60 words (#1137), or with no box a paragraph inside 320 characters or 60 words.
first_block_answers.decision: Narrowed. With no box, an opening inside 60 words passes even past 320 characters. An opening past both is still stopped, and #1178 splits it in code.

required_blocks.guards: Structure: the blocks every generated page carries (SPEC §7, 2026-09-29).
required_blocks.decision: Added by #1137 while this review was open. It asks nothing of a page that was not handed its block inputs, so no stored page can fire it; not measured here.

fit_claim.guards: A false claim about the business: a use, an audience or a category the knowledge base does not support.
fit_claim.decision: Added by #1136. A model's judgement of the sentences that name the business; not re-run here. Run once on the twelve stored drafts on 2026-10-03 (1.6¢): it stopped four of the five adverts (02, 08, 09, 10) and none of the other seven. 01, a brochure that claims no category, passes: favourable framing is allowed (D20).

do_not_claim.guards: False claims about the business: anything on the customer's never-claim list.

no_private_figure.guards: Meant: a figure only ReachKit measured, stated with no source. Did: failed any number that also appears anywhere in the stored report.
no_private_figure.decision: Removed. Every fire was a coincidence (24-hour, 12 questions, 40% more). A measured figure no source states is a number no fact holds, which `traceable_numerals` stops.
